scope: Owner-reported Map Data completeness regression: compare the R7-151+ wide/native shortcut against the R7-150 movement/AOI baseline on current Last War v21, then restore correctness-first scanning, remove unrequested Dispatch Quick Find, and harden Clear against transient live-server resolution failures.

resource.error: Resource detail enrichment produced no authoritative full Resource rows.

truck.error: Ordinary Manual Truck scan published no Truck records.

diagnosis: The R7-151 68-request wide path proves AOI index coverage but does not force complete record materialization for City/Resource/Monster on current v21; treating coverage indices as equivalent to a complete population scan was incorrect.

The R7-148/R7-150 direct Train-list-only shortcut is not a completeness substitute for world Truck population on current v21; the live same-server proof returned zero Truck rows while the movement/AOI scan returned 200.
The apparent 6-10 second speedup therefore traded away the core acceptance condition: population completeness.

implementation.scanner: Restore the R7-150 movement/AOI acquisition path for normal full-world kinds and remove the Truck/Railway-only zero-AOI scan shortcut from the ordinary full scan path.
implementation.quickFind: Remove the unrequested Dispatch Quick Find UI/API/backend path introduced by R7-151.
implementation.clear: Make live-server resolution advisory for status/local-data Clear so a transient bridge resolver exception cannot turn a completed Clear into 'The action could not be completed'.
implementation.publication: Keep exact 2500-block/10000-AOI completion and transactional publication gates unchanged.

limits: Counts are live population snapshots and may change; the comparison establishes order-of-magnitude completeness loss, not fixed expected counts.
Railway positive population is still population-gated on v21; this checkpoint changes ordinary scan correctness policy, not the existing zero-population evidence.

The movement/AOI route is slower (~2 minutes per server in these proofs). Future acceleration is allowed only if it reproduces the movement baseline population on the same live snapshot or an independently authoritative full-map source proves equivalent completeness.
